title: Structured exchange profile registry v1
description: The profiles a project holds its structured-exchange documents to, kept at .pi-outpost/structured-exchange.json in the project. Lists files rather than scanning a directory, so a stray file is never a rule and a missing one is an error.

profiles.description: Profile files, by path relative to the project directory. Each must stay inside the project.

default.description: The identifier of a registered profile that documents naming no profile are held to. Declaring one also refuses documents that name an unregistered profile, and version 1 documents.
